name: CommunityForensics ViT-S/384 (OpenSight) general AI-image detector
source_url: https://huggingface.co/Red-had1911/deepfake-detector-onnx (generative_detector.onnx — direct export of the original timm checkpoint model_v11_ViT_384_base_ckpt.pt; Community Forensics, Park & Owens U-Michigan, arXiv:2411.04125, MIT)
limitations: Checkpoint is not committed; download generative_detector.onnx from Red-had1911/deepfake-detector-onnx.
Trained on 2.7M samples across ~4,800 generators (Community Forensics, 2024).

Measured locally (2026-09-21, mixed 55-sample corpus): AUROC 0.56, FPR@50 0.04, recall@50 0.14 — precision is strong (reals read ~0.00-0.06) but recall is generator-limited: DALL-E mean 0.55, SD-Turbo recall 0.00, Hemg face-manipulation fakes read ~0.04 (that class belongs to crop_faces members).
Same-repo faceswap_detector.onnx was also evaluated on face crops and rejected — no separation between real faces and SBI blends (real 0.01-1.0, fake 0.02-0.99 overlapping).
The onnx-community auto-converted export (model.onnx, 2-logit) produces flat ~0.4-0.7 scores on every input — DO NOT use it; this profile uses the direct single-logit export.
Card preprocessing is resize-440 + center-crop-384; the adapter applies a direct 384 resize (small domain shift).
Scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
notes: Output (N,1) logit; sigmoid = P(AI-generated) on 0-100 scale.
